description: Bounded three-trial nearest-union probe of the tied token matrix
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,432 parameters at 99.060000%, a +0.060000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 93 prior macro-attempts in this family and 723 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0195/micro-0003 at 1,432 parameters and 99.06%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002, an FF-output union discarded at 98.91%. This macro tests at most three sequential minimum-distance scalar unions in the tied input/output token matrix, excluding unchanged token pairs already rejected. Hypothesis: the embedding matrix may retain a small redundancy band independent of the two shared FF maps. This is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because each candidate is the current least-distorting eligible token union, directly contrasting tensor-specific sensitivity with the preceding FF-input successes under a strict three-trial bound. Stop on the first discard/error, exhaustion, or cap; official acceptance and rollback remain solely controlled by the runner.
summary: All three bounded token-matrix unions qualified, reducing the retained frontier from 1,432 to 1,429 parameters; the final authorized trial retained 99.080000%. The automation stopped exactly at its declared three-trial cap.
